Name: Adonijah, Son of Haggith
Summary: Adonijah, David's son by Haggith, exalted himself to be king while David was old, gathered Joab and Abiathar, and after Solomon's anointing asked for Abishag as wife, for which Solomon had him executed.
KeyStory: Adonijah's bid for the throne and his execution.
RelatedPeople: King David; King Solomon; Haggith, Mother of Adonijah; Joab, Son of Zeruiah; Abiathar, Priest; Abishag, Shunammite
LifeLesson: Seizing a crown God has given to another is rebellion, not ambition.
